# cert/map: full certification list

> 320 cybersecurity certifications from 70 vendors, grouped by domain and ordered from beginner to expert. Prices are exam list prices in USD. Generated from data/certs.csv; last price check 2026-11-10.

Source: https://certmap.dev/
Dataset: https://certmap.dev/data/certs.csv and https://certmap.dev/data/certs.json
Licence: CC BY 4.0 (dataset), MIT (code)

## Communication & Network Security

### CWNA: Certified Wireless Network Administrator

Vendor-neutral enterprise Wi-Fi administration certification with a 60-question exam. It is the required base credential for the CWNP professional-level certifications.

- Vendor: CWNP
- Level: beginner
- Exam price: $275 (List price $274.99 (exam CWNA-110))
- Price checked: 2026-11-10
- Exam length: 90 minutes
- Exam format: written or multiple choice
- Renewal: every 3 years
- Official page: https://www.cwnp.com/certifications/cwna
- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/cwna.html

### JNCIA-Junos: Juniper Networks Certified Associate Junos

Foundational Junos networking certification covering CLI, interfaces and basic routing.

- Vendor: Juniper
- Level: beginner
- Exam price: $200
- Price checked: 2026-06-08
- Exam length: 90 minutes
- Exam format: written or multiple choice
- Renewal: every 3 years
- Official page: https://learningportal.juniper.net/juniper/user_activity_info.aspx?id=14354
- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/jncia-junos.html

### MNSA: MCSI Network Security Analyst

Practical network security analysis certification.

- Vendor: MCSI
- Level: beginner
- Exam price: Not published (Not in the vendor's current catalogue (checked 2026-11-10); kept for existing holders)
- Exam length: 3 days
- Exam format: written or multiple choice
- Renewal: does not expire
- Official page: https://www.mosse-institute.com/certifications.html
- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/mnsa.html

### Network+: CompTIA Network+

Foundational networking certification covering protocols, topologies and basic security.

- Vendor: CompTIA
- Level: beginner
- Exam price: $399
- Price checked: 2026-11-10
- Exam length: 90 minutes
- Exam format: written or multiple choice
- Renewal: every 3 years
- DoD 8140: approved
- Official page: https://www.comptia.org/certifications/network
- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/net-plus.html
- Compared with: CCNA (https://certmap.dev/certs/compare-net-plus-vs-ccna.html), Security+ (https://certmap.dev/certs/compare-net-plus-vs-sec-plus.html), A+ (https://certmap.dev/certs/compare-a-plus-vs-net-plus.html)
- Preparation:
  - Network+ Certification (CompTIA, official, free): https://www.comptia.org/en-us/certifications/network/
  - Network+ (V9) Practice Questions (CompTIA, official, free): https://www.comptia.org/en-us/certifications/network/practice-questions/
  - CompTIA Network+ N10-009 Training Course (Professor Messer, free): https://www.professormesser.com/network-plus/n10-009/n10-009-video/n10-009-training-course/
  - CompTIA Network+ Study Guide: Exam N10-009, 6th Edition (Sybex (Wiley)): https://www.wiley.com/en-us/-p-9781394235605

### CU NetSec: University of Colorado Fundamentals of Computer Network Security Specialization

Four-course University of Colorado System specialization covering secure system design, applied cryptography and PKI, penetration testing basics, and firewalls and intrusion detection. Course-based certificate assessed through projects on cloud instances, with no proctored exam.

- Vendor: Coursera
- Issued by: University of Colorado
- Level: intermediate
- Exam price: Not published (Coursera monthly subscription; the official page showed no monthly price (only an unrelated Coursera Plus annual offer). Coursera estimates 4 weeks at 10 hours a week (the page FAQ says about 16 weeks).)
- Exam format: hands-on, performance-based
- Renewal: does not expire
- Official page: https://www.coursera.org/specializations/computer-network-security
- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/coursera-colorado-network-security.html

### CWSP: Certified Wireless Security Professional

- Vendor: CWNP
- Level: intermediate
- Exam price: $350 (List price $349.99 (exam CWSP-208); requires a current CWNA)
- Price checked: 2026-11-10

### RITx MicroMasters: RITx Cybersecurity MicroMasters Program

Four graduate-level courses from Rochester Institute of Technology: Cybersecurity Fundamentals, Computer Forensics, Cybersecurity Risk Management and Network Security. Course-based MicroMasters credential with no single proctored exam.

- Vendor: edX

### CWPE: HTB Certified Wi-Fi Pentesting Expert

Practical exam on attacking WEP, WPS, WPA2, WPA3 and WPA-Enterprise networks, rogue access points and pivoting into internal networks, with a written report. Requires completing the Wi-Fi Penetration Tester job-role path.

- Vendor: Hack The Box
- Level: expert
- Exam price: $350 (Exam voucher only, two attempts; job-role path access sold separately)
- Price checked: 2026-11-10
- Exam length: 7 days
- Exam format: hands-on, performance-based
- Renewal: does not expire
- Official page: https://academy.hackthebox.com/preview/certifications/htb-certified-wi-fi-pentesting-expert
- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/cwpe.html

## Security Architecture & Engineering

### CCZT: Certificate of Competence in Zero Trust

Zero trust architecture and implementation certificate.

- Vendor: CSA
- Level: intermediate
- Exam price: $175 (Exam token includes two attempts, two-year window)
- Price checked: 2026-11-10
- Exam length: 120 minutes
- Exam format: written or multiple choice
- Renewal: does not expire
- Official page: https://cloudsecurityalliance.org/education/cczt
- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/cczt.html

### ECES: EC-Council Certified Encryption Specialist

Cryptography certification covering symmetric and asymmetric algorithms and their applications. Exam 212-81 has 50 multiple-choice questions in 2 hours.

- Vendor: EC-Council
- Level: intermediate
- Exam price: $249 (Remote-proctored exam voucher (ECES v3))
- Price checked: 2026-11-10
- Exam length: 120 minutes
- Exam format: written or multiple choice
- Renewal: every 3 years
- Official page: https://www.eccouncil.org/train-certify/ec-council-certified-encryption-specialist-eces/
- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/eces.html

### SCF: SABSA Chartered Security Architect, Foundation Certificate

Foundation level of the SABSA enterprise security architecture framework. Two modules (F1 and F2) of 48 multiple-choice questions and 60 minutes each, with a 75% pass mark per module.

- Vendor: SABSA
- Level: intermediate
- Exam price: Not published (Fee set by accredited education partners; candidates must attend an official SABSA Foundation course)
- Exam length: 120 minutes
- Exam format: written or multiple choice
- Renewal: does not expire
- Official page: https://www.sabsa.org/certification/
- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/sabsa-scf.html

### SecAI+: CompTIA SecAI+

Certification on securing AI systems and using AI in security operations, governance and compliance. Single 60-minute exam (CY0-001) with up to 60 questions.

- Vendor: CompTIA
- Level: intermediate
- Exam price: $298 (Exam CY0-001)
- Price checked: 2026-11-10
- Exam length: 60 minutes
- Exam format: written or multiple choice
- Renewal: every 3 years
- Prerequisites: Security+
- Official page: https://www.comptia.org/en-us/certifications/secai/
- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/secai-plus.html

### TAUx InfoSec: Tel Aviv University Unlocking Information Security Professional Certificate

Two Tel Aviv University courses covering vulnerabilities and exploits, cryptography, buffer overflows, and network and web offense and defense. Course-based certificate with no proctored exam.

- Vendor: edX
- Issued by: Tel Aviv University
- Level: intermediate
- Exam price: $268 (Program bundle price $268.19 shown on the edX page (list $297.99 for the courses bought separately); one-off payment, not a subscription.)
- Price checked: 2026-11-10
- Exam format: written or multiple choice
- Renewal: does not expire
- Official page: https://www.edx.org/certificates/professional-certificate/taux-unlocking-information-security
- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/edx-taux-unlocking-information-security.html

### CASP+: CompTIA SecurityX

Advanced security practitioner certification covering enterprise security architecture.

- Vendor: CompTIA
- Level: advanced
- Exam price: $544 (Formerly CASP+)
- Price checked: 2026-11-10
- Exam length: 165 minutes
- Exam format: written or multiple choice
- Renewal: every 3 years
- Prerequisites: Security+
- DoD 8140: approved
- Official page: https://www.comptia.org/certifications/securityx
- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/casp-plus.html

## OSINT

### Basel OSINT: Basel LEARN Open-Source Intelligence (OSINT)

Free self-paced OSINT course for financial and corruption investigators built around a simulated illegal fishing case that ends with an OSINT report. It awards a certificate of completion from the International Centre for Asset Recovery rather than an examined certification, and is widely used in the asset recovery and OSINT community.

- Vendor: Basel Institute
- Level: beginner
- Exam price: Free (Free self-paced eLearning course)
- Price checked: 2026-11-10
- Exam format: written or multiple choice
- Renewal: does not expire
- Official page: https://learn.baselgovernance.org/course/view.php?id=79
- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/basel-osint.html

### CO3: Certified Offensive OSINT Operator

Offensive OSINT and reconnaissance certification for red teamers covering attack surface mapping, people and company profiling, OPSEC and automated pipelines. Earned by submitting at least 15 flags in a 30-day practical challenge lab.

- Vendor: CyberWarFare Labs
- Level: beginner
- Exam price: $29 (Individual plan with 30 days of challenge lab access; 60 or 90 days cost $9 or $15 more; a $49 figure also appears on the page; a $49 figure also appears on the page)

- Renewal: does not expire
- Official page: https://cyberwarfare.live/certifications/offensive-osint-operator-co3

- Level: beginner
- Exam price: Not published (Foundational modules are open to anyone without a licence; the full pathway is included with a Chainalysis licence)
- Exam format: written or multiple choice
- Renewal: does not expire

- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/chainalysis-daf.html

Digital forensics certification offered by ISFCE since 2003. Applicants need approved training and 18 months of verifiable professional experience for the full designation.

- Vendor: ISFCE
- Level: intermediate
- Exam price: $495 (CCE Examination Test fee; recertification every two years costs $250)
- Price checked: 2026-11-10
- Exam format: written or multiple choice
- Renewal: every 2 years
- Official page: https://isfce.com/cce-certification.html
- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/isfce-cce.html

Investigator-track credential from Chainalysis Academy on tracing cryptocurrency transactions with Chainalysis tools. Chainalysis Digital Asset Fundamentals is a required prerequisite.

- Vendor: Chainalysis
- Level: intermediate
- Exam price: Not published (No per-seat fee; certifications are included with a Chainalysis licence)

- Renewal: does not expire

Mobile device unlocking, extraction, decoding and data review with Cellebrite Inseyets. Earned by passing a knowledge test and a practical skills assessment (80% minimum) at the end of the 2-day course; renewed every two years through a recertification exam.

- Vendor: Cellebrite
- Level: intermediate
- Exam price: Not published (Price on request (no public price; registration via Cellebrite Community portal); exam included with the 2-day course, usually taken as a 5-day CCO + CCPA bundle)
- Exam format: hands-on, performance-based
- Renewal: every 2 years
- Official page: https://cellebrite.com/training/cellebrite-training-inseyets/

- Vendor: Cellebrite

### CPENT: Certified Penetration Testing Professional

Fully practical penetration testing exam (CPENT AI) taken as one 24-hour session or two 12-hour sessions, followed by a written report. A score of 90 percent or higher also grants the LPT (Master) credential.

- Vendor: EC-Council
- Level: advanced
- Exam price: $999 (CPENT Exam + Range (store price); scoring 90% or higher also awards LPT (Master))
- Price checked: 2026-11-10
- Exam length: 24 hours
- Exam format: hands-on, performance-based
- Renewal: every 3 years
- Official page: https://www.eccouncil.org/train-certify/certified-penetration-testing-professional-cpent/
